name: goal_exact_f7_standardized_anchor_frozen_grab_trial_v1
feature: Frozen Day1-fitted StandardScaler output for F0v2 native trial aggregates; target days never refit source state.
calibration_repetitions: Native repetitions 1..N per user, day and class; class labels used only for those calibration trials.
metric: DocumentPersonalAnchorV2 standardized Euclidean: raw calibration MAD scale plus epsilon in each coordinate denominator; fixed source/calibration-only similarity temperature.
probability: Normalize exp(-class distance / calibration-fitted tau) stably; also evaluate fixed 0.5 F0v2 + 0.5 F7 mixture, matching the prior mixture weight. No classifier refit.
selection: Validation and previously inspected descriptive final are reported for every frozen budget. No arm, weight or threshold is selected from target labels; F7 is not promoted as a default from this screen.
boundary: Public eight-channel GRABMyo 2048 Hz same-user/day calibration; not own-device 250 Hz, unseen-person calibration or independent prospective confirmation.
